explanation: Eta electroproduction at W=1.4885 GeV is just above the p+η threshold (1.486 GeV) — within the EtaMAID grid (1.487–2.211 GeV) and kinematically reachable with beam 6.53 GeV for Q²=0.5 and cosθ*=0.2, but the center-of-mass momentum is only ~40 MeV, so the bremsstrahlung integral is extremely compressed and the NAG routine may return ifail=2. I generated a 1-point EXCLURAD input using model 3 (EtaMAID-2023), rc_mode=0 (full O(α)), vcut=0.166, bmom=6.53, ivec=1, with the required legacy error-terminator line. Because of the threshold proximity, run with scripts/run_exclurad_skip_unphys.sh rather than the default sequential runner, and inspect outputs for integration errors.
